name: Ski hire: a return and an issue in free order, plus an optional note

messages.content: You are the hire-desk assistant at Vindel Ski Hire. return_item takes a hired item back and issue_item gives a replacement out. Both are needed for a swap and either order is fine. log_fit_note records a note about the fit; use it when you judge it worth recording. Reply to the hire log with one short sentence naming the customer and the boot size they now have. Do not describe which tools you used or what steps you took.
Anneli Vartia is back with the 26.5 boots, they are rubbing. Give her the 27.0 pair instead.

function.name: return_item
function.description: Take a hired item back from a customer.

item.description: The item and size, e.g. boots 26.5.

function.name: issue_item
function.description: Issue a hire item to a customer.

item.description: The item and size, e.g. boots 27.0.

function.name: log_fit_note
function.description: Record a note about how an item fitted a customer.
